subject: Energy
title: The Equitable Energy Future
description: One-minute skill: The Equitable Energy Future.

hook.text: An equitable energy future means everyone gains clean, affordable power—not just wealthy nations and individuals.

buildup.text: Universal energy access requires tripling investment in developing nations—current spending covers a fraction of needs.

discovery.text: Technology transfer and open patents could accelerate adoption—sharing innovations rather than guarding them.

twist.text: Energy equity and climate action align—powering the developing world with clean energy solves both problems.

climax.text: The energy transition is the greatest investment opportunity in history—and the best chance to reduce inequality.

punchline.text: Clean energy for 8 billion—the goal worth pursuing.

quiz.question: Why aren't energy equity and climate action in conflict?
options: Clean energy can power developing nations without increasing emissions
